_comment: R-abyss-conquest: a public golden with Abyss jewels in its tree sockets (tools/sg-oracle/lua/abyss-probe.lua and crates/pob-calc/tests/abyss_luajit.rs make the same edit). Item 11 sits in socket 26725, item 5 in 55190.

strhash._comment: MINEFIELD-RUST R13, PassiveSpec.lua:1285 `pairs(changedNode.stats)`: which roll the two equal `(2-3)` patterns of this legion node take depends on the process. Measured on scenario amanamu-2500, node 22285 (rolls 3, 2); the fixture is a process that took Rust's order.

jewels._comment: PassiveSpec.lua:1136 `pairs(self.jewels)`, scenario tecrod-and-zorath, 20 processes (19 orders of all 57 keys): the socket order that decides a shared node; the file's order is 26725, then 55190.
